title.narrative: Climate Adaptation in Vennar Subbasin in Cauvery Delta Project

description.narrative: ADB and the Government of India are working together to reduce flood risks and improve the distribution of water for irrigation in the Cauvery Delta of the state of Tamil Nadu. The Climate Adaptation in Vennar Subbasin in Cauvery Delta Project aims to protect coastal districts from cyclones and flooding that is being made worse by climate change. The project is upgrading infrastructure and resectioning and strengthening embankments of six main channels totaling 235 kilometers. More robust flood control structures will reduce the frequency and impact of flooding. Thirteen pump stations are also being upgraded. The management systems of the Water Resources Department will also be strengthened, with greater participation by stakeholders in the planning and delivery of water services, better assessment of water resources, development of a decision support system, and training of officers.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3394: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 16 Jul 2024
Progress Toward Outcome: Project implementation consultants' services extended to 31 December 2021 to support the project until project completion.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Dec 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/44429/44429-013-apfs-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Aug 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/44429/44429-013-smr-en_23.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: As of Q3/2021, physical progress of CW-1 is 88%, CW-2-82%, CW-3-68%, CW-4, CW-5 and CW-6 have achieved 100%, Pumping schemes also achieved 100%. DSS package was awarded on 16 July 2021. The loan was closed on 30 June 2021.
